# Equation of state and thermodynamic functions {#sec-ch03}

This chapter describes the thermodynamic state of a kintera mixture and the functions that evaluate it: the species
order and the two state vectors (mole fractions in `ThermoX`, mass fractions in `ThermoY`); the ideal-gas equation
of state with its inversions; the heat capacities and internal energies, in the constant-heat-capacity baseline and
in the two opt-in models for temperature-dependent gases; the reference state at which the card gives its data and
the latent heat that follows from it; the entropy of gases and condensates, where the condensate entropy is derived
from the saturation curve; the saturation ratio as a diagnostic; and the moist adiabatic extrapolation that steps a
parcel in pressure or height while conserving its entropy. The phase-equilibrium solvers that the entropy and the
adiabat depend on are the subject of @sec-ch04; the saturation-pressure curves themselves belong to @sec-ch02. All
formulas are written for the species indices and symbols defined in @sec-ch03-species-state, and every scheme ends
with an executable check under `src/kintera_report/ch03/checks/` whose output is committed next to it.
